description.value: A two-site primitive campsite on Wallace Island Marine Provincial Park in the Gulf Islands, reachable only by boat from Chemainus — beautiful sheltered island scenery, but completely inaccessible to loaded touring cyclists without arranging water transport.

raw_osm.description: Tent pads for 2 tents, placed close together. Camp only on designated sites. 2 picnic tables. Pit toilet at Chivers Point site 10 min walk away.. No fires permitted. Stairs lead up steep bank to trail.
raw_osm.description:en: Attractive, Bring water - closest available Montague Harbour Provincial Park, Dionisio Point Provincial Park. Promontory suited to day use. Hiking trails.
raw_osm.description:landing: Boat run through rocks onto sand, pebbles or rock ledges between rock ribs at neck behind small promontory. Slight Exposure to N. Alternative landing from SE at high water. Approach from NW suited to all tide levels unless blocked by drift logs.
raw_osm.name: Cabin Bay Campsite (BCMT)
raw_osm.reservation:description: Camping fees apply year-round. Pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites or pay at site. Fee $5.00 per person per night (2019) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence comes from the OSM tags, which provide detailed on-site information: no water at the site ('Bring water - closest available Montague Harbour Provincial Park'), a pit toilet at an adjacent site 10 minutes away, capacity of 2 tents, 2 picnic tables, no fires permitted, and a pre-pay backcountry permit system. The BC Parks website confirmed Wallace Island Marine Park is a real, active provincial park but rendered mostly navigation rather than park-specific content. Reservations are confirmed via the OSM reservation:description referencing the BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.
concerns: Website rendered mostly navigation menus; detailed park-specific content did not load, limiting website-based verification.
Primarily a boat-access marine campsite; land-based cycling access is indirect (ferry plus water taxi or kayak).
Fee data in OSM reservation:description is explicitly dated 2019 and is likely outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active backcountry campsite within a BC provincial marine park; useful to Gulf Islands touring cyclists who reach it by water from the ferry network.
enrichment_extras.notes: A secondary reference website for this site exists at https://www.bcmarinetrails.org/map_site/12126 (OSM tag website:bcmt) and may contain more current details.

wow_evidence: Wallace Island Marine Provincial Park in the Gulf Islands ... completely inaccessible to loaded touring cyclists without arranging water transport
